title: Direct Deposits into a Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
Direct deposits post to the Pocketwire Personal Account as soon as Pocketwire receives the payer's file, which is up to the plan's early direct deposit days in calendar days before the payer's scheduled pay date; the early availability depends on when the payer sends the file and is never guaranteed for a given deposit.

Direct deposits do not count toward the plan's rolling 30-day receive limit, but a deposit that would take the ledger balance above the plan's maximum ledger balance is returned to the payer.

Direct deposits are accepted while the account is active, limited or locked; on a closed account they are returned to the payer.

The monthly direct-deposit total is an input of the reduced instant cash-out rate of the Pocketwire Personal Account and of the Pocketwire Advance eligibility rules.

| Account status | Direct deposit |
|---|---|
| Active, limited or locked | Accepted, unless it would take the ledger balance above the maximum ledger balance, in which case it is returned to the payer |
| Closed | Returned to the payer |

**Basis questions**

- *Is a deposit guaranteed to arrive early?* No; the early availability depends on when the payer sends the file.
- *Does a payroll deposit use up the rolling 30-day receive limit?* No; direct deposits do not count toward it.
